chars.Y: YASSINE: a young man wearing a navy-blue work coverall jacket with a bright yellow reflective stripe across the chest, dark grey work trousers, black sneakers.
chars.S: SALMA: a young woman wearing a dusty-pink hijab fully covering her head and neck, a long olive-green abaya-style coat, small gold watch.
chars.W: COWORKERS: several young women factory workers in identical light-blue work smocks, some in plain beige hijabs.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small modest Moroccan bedroom in Casablanca. YASSINE sits tensely on the edge of his bed holding his phone, looking scared over his shoulder. Behind him a large glowing dreamlike vision of SALMA stands with arms crossed, leaning toward him, staring at him with an intense determined look. Open tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, same small bedroom lit only by the phone screen. YASSINE sits on the floor against the bed, phone in one hand, the other hand rubbing his forehead, desperately thinking how to escape a relationship, worried face.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, same bedroom. YASSINE suddenly sits up straight with a sly scheming grin, one finger raised as if he just got a brilliant crazy idea, phone in his other hand.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, SALMA lies in her own cozy bedroom with patterned Moroccan blankets, holding her phone close to her face, reading a message, her eyes widening in surprise.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, YASSINE sitting on his bed typing on his phone with a fake sad, innocent expression, while behind his back his other hand has its fingers crossed, showing he is lying.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night, SALMA sitting up in her bed staring at her phone in cold silence, a suspicious, offended expression, one eyebrow raised, lips pressed.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, YASSINE lying on his back on his bed, phone resting on his chest, eyes closed, breathing out a huge sigh of relief with a calm happy smile.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Morning inside a Moroccan cable-wiring factory: long work tables covered with colorful electrical wires and car wiring harnesses. YASSINE walks in through the aisle with his bag, and all the COWORKERS at the tables turn their heads and stare at him, some whispering behind their hands. SALMA stands among them at a table, looking at him with a small cold smirk.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Same cable factory. YASSINE stands at his work table holding a bundle of wires, totally confused and sweating, looking around, while in the background two COWORKERS whisper to each other and glance at him mockingly.
